articles.title: A Safety Net for Kids with Disabilities Is Getting Thinner
articles.summary: The Office for Civil Rights is the government office that makes sure schools treat kids with disabilities fairly. Big budget cuts closed 7 of its 12 offices and threw out thousands of complaints — including one from a Texas mom named Liz Piñón.

articles.title: Drones Drop Food to a City Running Out of It
articles.summary: Ukrainian drones dropped four tonnes of food at 100 spots in Oleshky, a Russian-occupied city where about 6,000 people are running out of food. Officials say some residents have been eating weeds.

articles.title: Venezuela Frees Political Prisoners — and People Want Elections Next
articles.summary: Venezuela released a group of political prisoners on Saturday, days after its interim leader met with President Trump. Rights groups say fewer than half of the country's political prisoners have been freed, and the opposition wants free elections.
